impact_summary: Citywide catastrophic inundation; Mithi River overflowed; airport submerged; over 900 casualties
Extensive rail paralysis; Dadar, Hindmata, and Parel submerged; suburban road network halted
Coincided with 4.59m high tide; Malad wall collapse; airport runway overshoot; subways shut
Severe nocturnal flash flooding; Nair Hospital basement flooded; Western and Central railway stalled
Chembur and Vikhroli landslides; rainwater entered water purification complex at Bhandup
Harbour line cut off at Kurla; Gandhi market submerged under 4 feet of standing water
